I was so impressed I had to write a review! First of all, I had severe ear blockage and couldn't hear anything. After seeing the doctor, they used an endoscope to show me my earwax, which was full and then suctioned out. The doctor was incredibly patient. They used ear drops to soften the earwax three times because I kept complaining of pain. It's very hard and close to the eardrum, so ideally, ear drops should be used beforehand to soften the earwax for easier removal. However, the doctor didn't try to remove the hard part further. After removing all the earwax, they showed me the remaining earwax and examined my ear while explaining everything. The cost was very reasonable, as other reviews mentioned. And importantly, even though there were many patients, the doctor remained patient and didn't rush the treatment. 🥹💖

The doctor is super professional and very helpful. His assistance is very sweet. I'm from Italy and was traveling alone. I suddenly developed an ear infection, which I neglected and got worse.
